params.purpose_header: // Package logc provides context-aware logging wrappers.

params.source: var globalFields atomic.Value
var globalFieldsLock sync.Mutex

params.body:
fields = combineGlobalFields(fields)

switch atomic.LoadUint32(&encoding) {
case plainEncodingType:
	writePlainAny(writer, level, val, buildFields(fields...)...)
default:
	entry := make(logEntry)
	for _, field := range fields {
		entry[field.Key] = field.Value
	}
	entry[timestampKey] = getTimestamp()
	entry[levelKey] = level
	entry[contentKey] = val
	writeJson(writer, entry)
}

params.source:
type (
	LogConf = logx.LogConf
	LogField = logx.LogField
)
